title: BetterTogether Schedule
description: The cross-tool contract: an array of candidate schedules produced by BT-Optimizer (Python/z3) and consumed by BT-Implementer (C++ config_reader.hpp::readSchedulesFromJson). One schedule assigns every application stage to a processing unit as a sequence of contiguous chunks. Stage numbering is 1-based and inclusive: a chunk covers stages [start_stage, end_stage]; the chunks of a schedule must contiguously cover [1, n_stages] (the C++ validate_schedule_coverage gate enforces this at load). Producer validates against this schema before writing; consumer fails fast on any deviation.

uid.description: Opaque unique id for this candidate (e.g. SCH-...); used for logging/selection.

solution_id.description: 1-based rank of this candidate within the solver's output (metadata).

chunks.description: Contiguous chunks, in stage order, that partition [1, n_stages] across PUs.

core_type.description: Processing unit class. The single source of truth for the PU-string set (C++ and Python map this enum). 'GPU' additionally requires 'hardware'.

start_stage.description: First stage in the chunk (1-based, inclusive).

end_stage.description: Last stage in the chunk (1-based, inclusive); must be >= start_stage.

time.description: Predicted chunk time in ms (metadata; not consumed by the runtime).

hardware.description: Which GPU backend a GPU chunk runs on. Required iff core_type == 'GPU'.

metrics.description: Optimizer-side predicted metrics (makespan, gapness, speedups, baselines). Advisory; the runtime ignores them.
